run_adsorbml_pipeline: run the AdsorbML pipeline for a given slab and adsorbate using a pretrained ML model
generate_adsorbate_slab_configurations: generate multiple adsorbate-slab configurations from a slab structure and list of adsorbates
relax_atoms_with_calculator: relax atomic structures using an ASE calculator and optimizer then return energy and forces
reference_adsorbate_slab_energies: reference adsorbate-slab energies to atomic and slab reference energies for adsorption energy calculation
detect_adsorbate_anomalies: detect anomalies like dissociation desorption surface change or intercalation between initial and final atomic structures
